opening.argument: The roadside exchange is framed as a jumper-cable prank: the speaker asks someone to hold a Texas Roadhouse gift card above a vehicle battery, then says the participant is receiving a $20 gift card. The description separately links to Texas Roadhouse gift cards. Taken together, those facts show a staged gift-card interaction and ordinary promotion. Nothing in the described exchange or link asks viewers to invest, provide credentials, or take part in a financial arrangement; the record does not establish any loss or further outcome.
